title: The Wedding of a Thousand Guests

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: At a small wedding, a guest wonders whether distant weddings might have thousands of guests.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At a small wedding, (name1), a guest, wonders whether distant weddings might have thousands of guests.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The guests imagine dancing that never ends and food piled high.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A shy villager says such a crowd would be overwhelming.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder suggests that some couples far away might prefer quiet ceremonies, just like this one.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar says there might be as many ways to marry as there are peoples, and just as many good reasons not to marry at all.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The couple says this is exactly the size they wanted.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The couple admits they nearly invited everyone and are glad they did not.
